$comment: Sailing area (ROADMAP architecture hook 'Sailing areas as data'): loaded by id, no area names or numbers in code. PHASE3_SPEC 6.2. Other areas later = other files with the same keys.

position.source: Split harbour, read off a map (owner, Phase 3 plan: Split is the reference point). Sunrise and sunset differ by only a few minutes along the Croatian coast.

timeZone.name: Europe/Zagreb
timeZone.source: Wikipedia, Summer time in Europe: EU summer time runs from 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday in March to 01:00 UTC on the last Sunday in October; Croatia is on CET (UTC+1) / CEST (UTC+2).

sea.fetchNote: assumption: how far the wind blows over open water before it reaches the boat. Sheltered: a bay or a channel between islands; coastal: along the Croatian coast and between the outer islands; open: the open Adriatic (it is about 150–200 km wide).

marks.$comment: Practice buoys (PHASE3_SPEC 8, owner): fixed marks in metres east and north of where the boat starts. Not real buoys.

marina.$comment: A made-up Mediterranean marina (PHASE7_SPEC 8.2). Boats lie stern-to: the north row with the stern to the quay, the south row with the stern to the pontoon; the fairway runs east-west and is open to the west.

bay.$comment: A made-up Croatian bay 1.3 km west of the start (PHASE7_SPEC 11.2), cut into a coast that runs north-south at east -1350: open to the east, sand with a patch of sea grass, rocky shores, three hidden rocks, rings on the shore for shore lines, three mooring buoys.

clock.note: owner (issue #26, Phase 3 plan): without a time in the link the clock starts at noon, 1 June (local time)
